title: Monotonicity of trajectory properties
statement: Let $C$ be a contract, and let $R,R'$ be predicates on its data, starting configurations, and work-head position vectors. If $R$ holds throughout every eligible trajectory of $C$ and $R(i,d,p)$ implies $R'(i,d,p)$ for every datum $i$, configuration $d$, and head-position vector $p$, then $R'$ also holds throughout every eligible trajectory of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: R implies R′ for every datum, configuration, and head-position vector
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract for a machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $R$ and $R'$ be
predicates on data, configurations, and work-head positions. If $C$ satisfies $R$ along
every run covered by the contract, and $R$ implies $R'$ for every data value,
configuration, and head-position tuple, then $C$ also satisfies $R'$ along every such
run.
